findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 6 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 66 questions numbered 1-66; by section: 6.1 4, 6.2 9, 6.3 5, 6.4 8, 6.5 4, 6.6 11, 6.7 9, 6.8 6, 6.9 5, 6.10 5.

Covers every section in book order; every "difference" answer is a two-column table; answers are 2-4 lines. None repeats the chapter exercise (what is data science / machine learning / supervised learning, the two types of data, structured vs unstructured, two collection methods, purpose of feature selection, what accuracy measures, prediction vs causality and naming one tool are left to the exercise). Metric numericals use changed values computed in Python with the book's equations; the regression example uses the corrected output (MSE 0.1484, Exam Score = 0.6552 x Hours Studied + 0.1466).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
